title: QCOS Studio — Quantum Development Environment
description: A quantum programming language and its editor: readable programs with named qubits and real control flow, completion and hover, and compile and run through the QCOS API.

title: RepoRadar: Codebase Insights
description: Understand unfamiliar codebases, then discover better building blocks.

title: HAR Viewer & HAR File Analyzer (HTTP Archive)
description: HAR viewer and HAR file analyzer for .har files from browser DevTools: a request table with a timing waterfall, filters, headers, cookies and bodies. Copy as cURL or fetch, export filtered requests and save a redacted copy without tokens or cookies. Offline.

title: ProductEnv
description: See which ProductEnv environments define the variables your code reads

title: Audio Player & WAV Player (MP3, FLAC, LUFS)
description: Audio player and WAV player for VS Code: play WAV, MP3, FLAC, Ogg, Opus and M4A with a waveform, spectrogram, A-B loop and LUFS loudness. Offline.

title: File Viewers Pack: PDF, Excel, CSV, Parquet, Word, PowerPoint
description: File viewers for VS Code in one pack: open PDF, Excel, CSV, Parquet, Word, PowerPoint, HDF5, NetCDF and model tensor files, with dark mode and search.

title: GCode Viewer, CNC Viewer & 3D Print Preview
description: G-code viewer and CNC viewer for 3D printing and CNC milling in VS Code. See the toolpath in 3D by feature or speed, step through layers, play the print, check print time and filament, and jump to the line.

title: ZIP Viewer & Archive Viewer (JAR, TAR, GZ)
description: ZIP viewer and archive viewer for ZIP, JAR, VSIX, TAR, TAR.GZ and GZ files in VS Code. Browse them without unpacking. Open entries in editor tabs, search names and extract safely.

title: Font Viewer, TTF Viewer, OTF & WOFF Viewer
description: Font viewer for TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 and TTC fonts in VS Code. See every glyph, test sample text with variable axes and OpenType features, and read the license.

title: Claude Limits Meter
description: Unofficial: shows your Claude Code usage (5-hour session and 7-day weekly limits) in the VS Code status bar. Works on Linux, macOS, Windows, WSL and remote hosts. Thanks to Claude Usage Bar by Harsh Agarwal, whose source helped.

title: Veyra Wrapped: Your Year in Code
description: Your Git history as a story to share: commits, lines written, your coding hours, longest streak, top languages and files, and your coding personality. Save a card for X or LinkedIn. Private: nothing leaves your computer.

title: MD Multi-Tool
description: A collection of small productivity tools for VS Code, starting with Insert Date (YYYY-MM-DD).

title: DSH Chat (DeepSeek Harness)
description: Connect VS Code to your local DeepSeek Harness instance — right-dock chat, model routing, thinking effort, file attachments and sessions synced with the local harness store.
